cohort: 3242 live births at a public maternity hospital in Tabatinga, Brazil, between January 2015 and December 2017
finding: Brazilian women had more prenatal consultations, caesarean sections, and premature births, while Peruvian and Colombian women started antenatal care later and those with high-risk pregnancies tended to deliver in their home country.
mod_finding: Brazilian pregnant women had more caesarean sections.
